claims.exact_statement: For every K>=0 and arbitrary finite disjoint uniform-cube Boolean factors, the full physical stopping hull R_K of (H-KI)_+ tensorizes exactly: R_K(product_i f_i)=sum_i R_K(f_i), with no root-sign hypothesis. Always 0<=H-R_K<=KI, and for 0<=K<=L, 0<=R_K-R_L<=(L-K)I; R_K is convex piecewise affine in K. For every actual disjoint-core Boolean composition F=B(g_i), pivotal probabilities q_i and signed correction C=H(F)-sum_i q_i H(g_i), the bank A=C+kappa I(F)+sum_i q_i R_K(g_i) satisfies H(F)+(kappa-K)I(F)<=A<=H(F)+kappa I(F). Any two representations of the same F at the same K,kappa differ by at most K I(F). With fixed kappa, unbounded A/I implies an actual ordinary H/I counterfamily, even with varying K; the converse holds at bounded K. The clipped bank A_plus=C_+ +kappa I+sum_i q_i R_K(g_i), even though not universally coherent, obeys A_plus/I-kappa<=max(H(F)/I(F),max_{i:q_i I(g_i)>0} H(g_i)/I(g_i)); its unbounded root ratio therefore extracts an actual whole-or-core Boolean counterfamily. Products cannot amplify a finite A/I or R_K/I at fixed K,kappa. For F_t the product of t independent two-bit functions negative only at00, H=2t,I=t,Var=1-4^-t,R_K=t(2-K)_+, providing sharp bank endpoints at0<=K<=2 and divergent variance/average-influence normalizations despite H/I=2. No universal initial bank bound, no full FEI proof, and no unbounded ordinary-ratio family is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite {-1,1}-valued functions on independent uniform physical bits; H is Shannon entropy in bits of the normalized squared Fourier law, I is total physical influence.
K>=0; every R_K is the true complete finite physical stopping hull, with all adaptive queries and both full outcomes retained; factors have disjoint supports.
Composition cores and outer gate are actual Boolean functions, allowing constants/dummies; q_i are actual independent biased-output pivotal probabilities, not substituted formal parameters.

Counterexample extraction uses fixed kappa, nonconstant actual whole functions, and actual full influence denominators; bounded K is required only in stated converse and representation-sequence comparisons.

Initial-bank algebra is unconditional. Nonnegative coherent status of the signed bank at kappa=6 is the separate A072 theorem reviewed by A074; no fresh original owner credit or repeated repartition payment is inferred.

claims.exact_statement: For every finite Boolean outer gate h and disjoint finite Boolean inner functions g_j on independent uniform physical bits, including constants and dummies, fix the original partition under restriction, put F=h(g), q_j equal to the true pivotal probabilities, and C=H(F)-sum_j q_j H(g_j), with base2 squared-Fourier entropy. For a physical query i in block j let mu=E g_j, t=ghat_j({i}) and d=Inf_i(g_j). Then mean C_child-C_parent <= q_j*(abs(t)*(abs(mu)+abs(t))+2*d)/ln2 <= (3/ln2)*Inf_i(F) <= (9/2)*Inf_i(F). For kappa=3/ln2 or9/2, C+kappa I(F) is nonnegative and full-query superharmonic. For every K>=0, adding sum_j q_j rho_K(g_j), where rho_K is the complete inner stopping hull of (H-KI)_+, gives a nonnegative full-query superharmonic majorant A_K of (H(F)-K I(F))_+. Actually supplied credit at least A_K can be propagated with conditional-mean-conserved old nonnegative credit owners and old signed debit labels, both full children and spent outside donors preserved. The coefficient is sufficient, not claimed optimal. No dimension-independent initial price is asserted: singleton physical cores give A_K=H(F)+kappa I(F), whose influence payment is FEI-equivalent. Moreover, for every such fixed partition and K>=0, H(F)+(kappa-K)*I(F)<=A_K<=H(F)+kappa*I(F): the inner savings H(g_j)-rho_K(g_j) lie in[0,K*I(g_j)]. Thus dimension-independent initial influence funding at any fixed K is FEI-equivalent for arbitrary choices of partition, not only singleton cores.
